_comment: OMN-14498 Lane C seam fixture. A poisoned command as it arrives at the auto-wired consume boundary: the ingress correlation_id is carried on the Kafka message HEADERS (ModelEventMessage.headers.correlation_id), while the message VALUE is truncated JSON that json.loads() cannot decode. This is the exists-but-wrong shape: the boundary cannot recover lineage from the body, so a pre-fix boundary mints a fresh uuid4() and the DLQ record -- and therefore every replay of it -- carries a VALID id with the WRONG lineage, producing an orphan terminal.
